title: President Signs Grain to Alcohol Production Bill

subtasks.task_text: The President signs a bill enabling the Department of Agriculture to convert grain into alcohol for fuel use.
subtasks.text: The President states the purpose of the bill, which is to enable the Department of Agriculture to take grain in storage and convert it into alcohol for fuel use.

subtasks.task_text: The President signs a bill enabling the Department of Agriculture to convert grain into alcohol for fuel use.
subtasks.text: The President explains that this bill will help by reducing the threat to legitimate grain pricing due to the large stock of government-held grain.
The President prepares to sign the bill.
The President signs the bill and states that it is now law.
